title: Core: AS2 delete operator and in operator
description: Test compilation of: (1) delete obj.prop — should emit ActionDeleteMember or ActionDelete2; (2) delete arr[i] — array element deletion; (3) 'key' in obj — ActionEnumerate2 or membership test; (4) for..in loop: for (var k in obj) — emits ActionEnumerate2 (0x55) + ActionNextMember (0x19); (5) delete local variable: delete x. Document which opcodes are actually emitted by the compiler.
